summary: Pulley Calculator feature testing completed successfully. All 23 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend testing verified all UI components and integrations work correctly including Pulley tab navigation, form configuration, hub type selection (No Hub/With Hub/KLA), calculation, and Add to Cart integration.
critical_code_review_comments: Pulley pricing uses MOCK/PLACEHOLDER rates (not real prices from user's Excel) - this is expected and documented in the UI with a notice card
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pulley Calculator is a new feature fully implemented and tested. Backend APIs: GET /api/pulley-standards, POST /api/calculate-pulley-cost, GET /api/pulley-thicknesses/{pipe_dia}, GET /api/pulley-kla-model/{shaft_dia_hub}. Frontend: Pulley tab in bottom nav (3rd tab), full configuration form with all sections working. Add to Cart integration with shared cart system working.
mocked_api_notice: Pulley pricing uses placeholder/mock rates in pulley_standards.py - not real prices from user's Excel template

POST_calculate_pulley_cost_quantity_pack.details: Quantity and packing charges calculated correctly
